# EmptyState

> What a screen says when there's nothing on it yet. One of Rost's drawings, a line saying why, a sentence on what to do, and the button that does it.

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/empty-state/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/empty-state.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Anatomy

- `root`: A column, centred, 16px between its parts and 40px around them.
- `illustration`: An Illustration, as it is, 72px.
- `title`: Sub-title type, medium weight, in the main text colour.
- `body`: Paragraph type, a step quieter, no wider than 320px so it stays a short block.
- `action`: A Button, as it is.

## When to use

- **Nothing here yet.** A list or a screen before its first item: no clients, no invoices this month. Say why, and offer the way to the first one.

## When not to use

- **No results.** A search that found nothing needs one line in place of the results, not a drawing.
- **Errors.** Something that failed. That's **InlineBanner**, with what to do.

## Behaviour

A drawing, a title, a sentence and at most one Button, centred. It adds nothing to the drawing or the Button: they're Rost's own.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: A `<div>`. The title is a heading (`h2` by default, `as` changes it) so it's found by headings.
- **Name**: The title.
- **Colour**: The title is 14:1 and the sentence 11:1 on the dark page. The drawing is decoration and is hidden from screen readers.

## Content

The title says why ("No invoices yet"), the sentence what to do, the button the verb ("New invoice").
